summary: Ran step M5-S03 (docs, owner story-drafter) of build case-onboarding. The step was returned by `build_plan.py next --milestone M5`, was claimed running at 2026-09-12T10-21-24Z, and is now built. story-drafter is a borrowed Tier-2 roster agent with no build-layer clause in its contract (the Step 4 grep scored 0), so its Plan was executed inline under the artefact-path constraint and it wrote straight to the declared output rather than to its own default_output_dir; no relocation was needed and none was performed. One declared output, artefacts/M5-S03/story-backlog.md, exists and is non-empty; check-outputs reports ok with empty missing/empty/malformed. The step's declared checker, check_invest.py --manifest-dir artefacts/M5-S03, exits 0 from the build directory with 11/11 stories passed, 0 ERROR and 10 word-count WARNs. No file was written anywhere outside the build directory.
confidence_rationale: Step 9 HIGH row is met on every mechanical count — the step was in next, all three required inputs resolved from plan.json alone, both envelopes validate, check-outputs exited 0 and nothing landed outside artefacts/M5-S03. Held at MEDIUM by the Step 9 optional-input row: three optional inputs of the owning agent (target_org_alias, release_capacity_points, priority_overrides) had no value in any of the three Step 5 sources, and the owning agent degraded rather than defaulting silently — it recorded each as a skipped dimension and capped its own confidence at MEDIUM.

dimensions_skipped.reason: story-drafter's Persistence section requires a docs/reports/story-drafter/<run_id>.{md,json} pair, but AGENT.md Step 6 clause 1 and the invocation both constrain every write to the build directory; the pair was therefore not written and the envelope lives under envelopes/M5-S03/ instead.
dimensions_skipped.retry_hint: Resolve the contract tension in agents/story-drafter/AGENT.md or in the runner's Step 6 clause 1; do not write outside the build dir to satisfy it.

dimensions_skipped.reason: Every metadata-builder step in this build wrote an artefacts/<step>/deploy-order.md, but story-drafter's Output Contract names no such file and the step declares one output; standards/build-orchestration.md section 4 condition 2 forbids an output the owning agent does not produce. UNVERIFIED items were recorded inline in the backlog's Process Observations instead.
dimensions_skipped.retry_hint: If the build wants a per-step deploy-order note on docs steps, re-own the step or add the file to a metadata-builder step.

process_observations.observation: Borrowing a non-Tier-4 roster agent worked exactly as standards/build-orchestration.md section 4 describes: all three of story-drafter's required inputs were bound by the planner in inputs{}, so nothing had to be inferred and no blocked exit was needed.

The step's inputs.note pre-resolved three defects this run would otherwise have hit — it moved uat-test-cases.yaml and acceptance-criteria.md to M5-S04 (B11/W09), dropped check_ac_format.py because it exits 2 over a prose backlog, and wrote discovery_artifact_path as the repo-relative path the runner actually passes (W07).

check_invest.py's rebuilt story-heading detection behaved as its docstring promises on a real seven-section backlog: the Summary, Persona anchors, RTM, MoSCoW check, Process Observations and Citations sections were skipped and exactly the 11 story sections were linted.

Three skill paths the owning agent first wrote into recommended_skills[] did not resolve on disk (admin/web-to-case-and-email-to-case, admin/queue-design, apex/trigger-handler-pattern) and were corrected against the registry before the document was finalised; a run that skipped that check would have shipped a backlog pointing three build agents at nothing.

story-drafter's Wave 10 persistence contract and the runner's write constraint disagree for every borrowed build-unaware agent: one requires a docs/reports/<agent-id>/ pair, the other forbids writing outside the build directory, and nothing in either contract says which wins.

AGENT.md Step 7's relocation machinery did not engage because the owner was executed inline and wrote straight to the declared path; the relocation table assumes a host that can invoke the owner as a subagent with its own persistence, so an inline run produces a clean result the table cannot distinguish from a host-invoked one.

The owning agent minted seven requirement ids (REQ-052 to REQ-058) as part of its Step 1 parse; that is inside its contract, but no agent in this loop owns the build-wide REQ- sequence, so M5-S04's compile could mint colliding ids from the same clarification group.
M5-S03 is now built and its acceptance tests have not been executed by the tester.
process_observations.followup_reason: Because built is not tested: step-tester runs the declared checker and the manual line and writes tests/M5-S03/results.json, which set-status tested requires.

process_observations.observation: M5-S04 depends on M5-S03 and cannot enter next until this step reaches documented.
process_observations.followup_reason: Because it documents this step and then owns the compiled UAT pack and acceptance-criteria document the backlog feeds.

judging the artefact layout — a docs step producing one markdown document under artefacts/<step-id>/ needs no source-format tree

extensions.invocation_mode: inline — the owning agent's Plan was executed in-process per AGENT.md Step 6 'in any other host', as this build has done throughout
extensions.relocation_note: None. The owner was executed inline under the Step 6 clause-1 path constraint and wrote directly to the declared output, so no file existed at its default_output_dir to move or copy.

declared_checkers.note: Run by the runner as evidence only; step-tester owns the authoritative execution and results.json. The test declares no --strict, so the 10 body-word-count WARNs do not fail it.

manual_acceptance_test.satisfied_by: story-backlog.md — email (US-CASE-001, US-CASE-002), web (US-CASE-003) and manual UI (US-CASE-004) each have a story; all 11 stories name a Profile+PSG persona and none names the admin; every story carries 3-5 GWT criteria with at least one permission-denial or restriction criterion
manual_acceptance_test.verdict: ticked at the milestone gate by a human, not by this agent
